d:
Israil men chunav ho chuke hain. egzit pols ke anuman samne aa rahe hain aur kuchh dinon men antim natije bhi samne honge. philhal egzit pols men anuman lagaya ja raha hai ki gadi aaizenkot ke gathbandhan ko sabse zyada siten mil sakti hain lekin israili sansad men sabse bari akeli parti netanyahu ki likud parti ho sakti hai. agar chunavi natijon men bhi aisa hi huaa to aage kya hoga?
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
